scope.positioning: API flag parity covers migration-critical goctl api go and api format flags without claiming a full goctl formatter clone.
scope.referenceFramework: goctl api go --test, goctl api go --type-group, goctl api format --stdin, and goctl api format --declare

compatibilityPolicy.apiGoStyle: An explicitly provided --style go_zero must select the same go-zero-compatible behavior as --profile gozero-compatible while retaining the gofly-native project layout; conflicting explicit values must fail.
compatibilityPolicy.apiGoTest: The --test flag must generate handler smoke tests beside handlers in internal/api/http/v1 within the gofly-native layout.
compatibilityPolicy.apiGoTypeGroup: The --type-group flag must group DTO files by @server group in internal/model and keep shared DTOs in types.go.
compatibilityPolicy.apiFormatStdin: The --stdin flag must read API content from standard input and emit formatted content to stdout or the requested output file.
compatibilityPolicy.apiFormatDeclare: The --declare flag skips missing type declaration checks during API formatting, matching goctl's migration-critical formatter behavior.

apiSurfaces.behavior: both explicit selectors enable the same go-zero-compatible behavior without changing the gofly-native project layout, and conflicting selectors fail

apiSurfaces.goflySurface: gofly api go --test / gofly api gen --test
apiSurfaces.behavior: generates handler smoke tests beside gofly-native HTTP handlers

apiSurfaces.goflySurface: gofly api go --type-group / gofly api gen --type-group
apiSurfaces.behavior: writes per-group DTO files in internal/model and keeps cross-group DTOs in types.go
reads API source from stdin and writes formatted output to stdout or --output
skips missing type declaration checks while preserving formatted API output

nextPromotionCriteria: Keep api-format-declare implemented only while missing type declaration checks fail by default and pass with --declare.
Keep --test and --type-group promoted only while generated route tests and split type files are covered by command and generator tests.
Do not describe API flag support as full goctl parity unless every requiredFlag has implemented status and a runnable gate.
